name: Masscan port check
description: Checks up to 100 ports on one IPv4 address with the Masscan program at a capped rate. Needs raw sockets already allowed for your account.
externalRestrictions: ACTIVE: it sends traffic to the target. Only use it on systems you own or have written permission to test. Every run is recorded in the audit log on this computer, needs your confirmation each time, and is never routed through Tor or any proxy. Masscan is AGPL software: Mayfair never bundles it and runs it only as a separate program. Rate is capped at 100 packets per second and one address per run. Ghost never asks for administrator rights; if raw sockets are not already allowed the run fails and says so. It is a separate program, not part of Mayfair: Ghost downloads it into its tools folder on first use (checksum verified, then tested) or you point Ghost at your own copy. It is shown as installed only after its own self-test passes.
